text.p: These were the headlines on Latvian state radio at noon on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- Prime Minister Andris Shkele has asked for the resignation of Defence Minister Andrejs Krastinsh, accusing him of the improper use of state funds by buying large amounts of fuel.
- The central bank celebrates the fifth anniversary of the introduction of the Latvian rouble, which was then replaced by the current currency, the lat.
